documented_probe: C-92a7a9c8 (embed documents at a fixed revision, rank by cosine similarity, return the selected document): this task exercises the full capability — encode documents and query with the revision-pinned shipped embedder, rank by cosine, select rank-k, and honor revision/stale-cache semantics on hidden cases.
notes: Failure modes probed directly: a stale embedding cache computed at an older revision (must be detected via the stored revision and recomputed), a manifest/weights revision mismatch (must exit nonzero with no output), and hidden cases with different pinned revisions/weights/documents (hard-coding the visible revision or ranking fails). Rubric nonzero for adversarial_inputs (stale cache + mismatch trap), hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact ranking/selection).
